changes: Recognition model changes from Whisper Small to Whisper large-v3-turbo, the only model in the package. The runtime lock rejects any other model, including a hash-locked Small runtime. The CPU path uses the same model.
The cached CUDA probe is keyed on the model too, so the first run after updating re-probes CUDA with Turbo.
Cue-first research code (not enabled in the panel) reads the Turbo runtime profile.
knownLimitations: Native Premiere import, playback, caption timing, markers, real run time and GPU memory alongside Premiere are not verified for this build.
CPU recognition is about 2x slower than Small (26.5 s clip: 18.1 s vs 8.7 s on an i7-14700K). CPU is the default without the CUDA download and on AMD/Intel.
Antarctica cue 138 ('nước hồ giàu sắt') is heard as 'dầu sắc' and goes to manual review; Small kept this cue.
Languages other than Vietnamese are not measured with Turbo.
The package is about 1.5 GB (was about 490 MB). An old Small copy in %LOCALAPPDATA%\PremiereVoiceSync\Models is left in place.
Six Windows integration groups (installer lifecycle, rollback, panel registry, notification shortcut, native and incident notifications) were not run for this build.
The cue-first Beta workflow is not enabled; both panel buttons use the existing 2.20.x workflow.
